programme.desc: Master chef Pascal Brodnicki shows viewers how to replace traditional dishes with Asian dishes.It proves that preparing an original dinner is simple and does not have to cost much.In search of culinary inspiration, he goes to Vietnam, Laos and Thailand.He shops at local markets, prepares and sells snacks on the street, and works on a rice plantation.To prove himself, he prepares exotic dishes for his Asian hosts.He tries grilled gecko and baked ant larvae, and accepts an invitation to an unusual hunt The next stop on Pascal Brodnicki's culinary journey is Laos, whose cuisine is famous for its unusual ingredients.Flowers, insects, frogs, tadpoles, insect cocoons, lizards, geckos and even squirrel meat are eaten here.Fried seaweed, khai pene, is the culinary trademark of Luang Prabang, a city located in the north of the country.In Laos, hundreds of families earn their living by harvesting seaweed.The traveling chef found out what their job is all about.For several hours he collected algae from the bottom of the Mekong, then cut them and rolled them into long sheets.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Master chef Pascal Brodnicki shows viewers how to replace traditional dishes with Asian dishes.It proves that preparing an original dinner is simple and does not have to cost much.In search of culinary inspiration, he goes to Vietnam, Laos and Thailand.He shops at local markets, prepares and sells snacks on the street, and works on a rice plantation.To prove himself, he prepares exotic dishes for his Asian hosts.He tries grilled gecko and baked ant larvae, and accepts an invitation to an unusual hunt A traveling chef learns about the peculiarities of southern Vietnam.Hanoi is a place where different cultures meet.The restaurants serve delicacies known all over the world, such as egg omelette.Seafood is popular, including huge snails weighing several kilograms.The main export of this part of Vietnam is ngoc mam fish sauce.Pascal Brodnicki will have the opportunity to present his culinary skills in difficult conditions.At a street eatery in Saigon, he will prepare three dishes in five minutes.

programme.title: American Adventure with Guy
programme.desc: Guy Fieri with his family and friends set off on a journey from northern California through Oregon to Washington.During the camper trip, they will have many fun competitions and wonderful feasts.

programme.title: American Adventure with Guy
programme.desc: Guy Fieri with his family and friends set off on a journey from northern California through Oregon to Washington.During the camper trip, they will have many fun competitions and wonderful feasts.

programme.title: A race around taste
programme.desc: Each round, world-class chefs are taken to an iconic culinary destination.There they must use their experiences and knowledge to impress the resident - Daniela Soto-Innes.

programme.title: Man vs World
programme.desc: Rob Bell, an adventurer, athlete and engineer, sets off on a journey during which he will travel only in vehicles powered by human muscles.Every morning the traveler will take on a new challenge.Wanting to visit as many places as possible and reach the destination before sunset, he will learn about disciplines such as canyoning, paragliding, mountain biking, mountain kayaking, coasteering and mountainboarding.During the expedition, he will cover difficult areas of South Africa, Poland, the Czech Republic and Great Britain.He will also meet many guides who will give him advice on how to navigate the cliffs, slopes and river gorges.When Rob undergoes this endurance test, he will see the world from a completely new perspective.

programme.title: Man, Woman, Wild
programme.desc: In the program, a married couple takes up the challenge and tries to survive in the wilderness.Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a television journalist.We will meet them in the most remote and dangerous corners of the world, where they will have to survive for four days with only a knife.This is one of the most difficult exams that will test not only their resilience, but also the durability of their marriage in extreme situations.Mykel was taught how to survive in any conditions.However, for Ruth, encounters with wildlife are a completely new experience.A man will have to teach his wife how to build a roof over her head and how to look for food.

Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: The Zoo: The Marvelous Mott Mott
programme.desc: Beloved camel Max develops a large abscess on the top of his head a marmot prepares for her first classroom visit as an ambassador animal a peregrine falcon found at the base of a skyscraper is brought to the zoo for a health check.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: My Pup From Hell
programme.desc: Jackson works with Sydney, a Bengal, who's welcoming his new stepmom and new pit bull brother into the family by spraying every piece of furniture in the house an energetic cat, Stella, threatens to harm a toddler.

programme.title: Mystery of the Lost Islands: Killer Whale Island
programme.desc: Predator expert Dave Salmoni travels to a remote speck of land in the wild and stormy South Atlantic, which is visited by a huge number of hunting killer whales.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Tiger Eyes
programme.desc: Hunter the Sumatran tiger is blind and must be sedated for his annual eye check the keepers prepare young giraffe Scarlett for a road trip to South Australia, reuniting her with family.

programme.title: Meet the Orangutans: Settling In
programme.desc: One orphan is new on the scene and needs another, more experienced one to help them settle in the babies are at high risk from parasites ingested from the ground.
